title: Da capo
html_source: Da capo, pronounced [da (k)ˈkaːpo], is a musical term in Italian, meaning from the beginning (literally from the head). It is often abbreviated D.C. It is a composer or publisher’s directive to repeat the previous part of music, often used to save space.
